 p=root/b['path']
 assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==b['sha256'],b

   r=c.post(p+'/snapshots',headers=h,content=json.dumps(dict(request_key='bad-base',source_version=v,base=base)))
   assert r.status_code==422,(base,r.text)
